newsitem.title: ITALY: San Paolo sees privatisation in 1997.
newsitem.headline: San Paolo sees privatisation in 1997.

text.p: Italy's largest banking group San Paolo di Torino will be privatised in 1997, said the bank's chairman Gianni Zandano.

"In 1997, I think we will do it," he said while attending a banking conference in this northern central Italian city. Around 65 percent of San Paolo is currently held by the charity foundation holding company, Compagnia di San Paolo.
San Paolo has said before it was looking forward to privatisation, but Zandano added that now the bank is in sight of a precise plan to be enacted in 1997.
He said that the progress of privatisation would take place independently of a draft law going through parliament which is aimed at encouraging foundations to sell their banking stakes.
